ios.desc:
Paperly is a free PDF editor, PDF scanner, PDF reader, OCR scanner, and document management app designed to help you scan, organize, edit, convert, and manage documents privately.

Turn your iPhone or iPad into a professional document scanner and PDF toolkit for receipts, notes, contracts, invoices, study materials, certificates, forms, and everyday documents.

PDF SCANNER

Scan documents with your camera using automatic edge detection and create clean, high-quality PDF files from scanned pages and images.

PDF EDITOR & READER

Read, organize, and edit existing PDF files. Crop, rotate, and reorder pages, merge multiple PDFs, split documents, extract pages, and manage your files in one place.

OCR & TEXT EXTRACTION

Extract text from scanned documents and images with built-in OCR. Paperly supports multiple languages including English, Hindi, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, and Russian.

OCR processing is performed locally on your device.

OFFLINE AI INTELLIGENCE

Paperly includes AI-powered document tools designed to run locally on your device.

• Auto Detection helps identify document content and simplify document workflows.
• Magic Eraser helps remove unwanted elements from supported document and image workflows.

These AI capabilities operate locally without requiring your documents to be uploaded to a cloud service.

PDF CONVERTER

Convert and export PDF documents to commonly used formats including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Text, CSV, PNG, and JPG.

SIGN, ANNOTATE & FILL PDFS

Add signatures, annotations, notes, and markups to your PDFs. Fill PDF forms for reviewing, signing, sharing, or submission.

MERGE, SPLIT & ORGANIZE

Combine multiple PDF files into one document or split PDFs into separate pages. Extract, reorder, and organize your documents efficiently.

PDF COMPRESSION

Reduce PDF file size for easier storage and sharing.

PDF SECURITY & REDACTION

Protect sensitive PDF files with password security. Permanently redact sensitive information from supported documents and add watermarks and custom stamps.

ID CARD SCANNING

Scan supported identification documents and manage the resulting files digitally.

PDF COMPARISON

Compare document versions and identify differences between PDFs, contracts, forms, reports, and other documents.

KEY FEATURES

• Free PDF Editor
• PDF Reader & PDF Viewer
• PDF Scanner
• Document Scanner
• OCR & Text Extraction
• Multilingual OCR
• Offline OCR
• Offline AI Intellige
